accepted.sentence: A few drops of valve oil on clean pistons help them move quickly and return smoothly after each finger press.
In fast passages, alternating tongue syllables like “ta” and “ka” allows repeated notes to be articulated without interrupting airflow.
A fluttering tongue rolled against the roof of the mouth adds a rough, buzzing effect while the player sustains a note.
Moving a plunger mute toward and away from the bell creates changing, speech-like wah effects during a phrase.
Players produce vibrato by subtly wavering pitch or intensity, often through controlled jaw motion or changes in breath pressure.
The performer typically supports the instrument with the left hand while the right fingers operate its valves.
After use, the mouthpiece can be removed and cleaned separately to clear saliva and residue from its narrow passage.
A lip trill alternates rapidly between neighboring harmonic notes, usually without changing valve positions.
